mapper.insert: INSERT INTO med_schedule ( doctor_id, clinic_room_id, shift_template_id, work_date, start_time, end_time, slot_duration_minutes, capacity_per_slot, status ) VALUES ( #{doctorId}, #{clinicRoomId}, #{shiftTemplateId}, #{workDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{startTime,jdbcType=TIME}, #{endTime,jdbcType=TIME}, #{slotDurationMinutes}, #{capacityPerSlot}, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, work_date, start_time, end_time, slot_duration_minutes, capacity_per_slot, status FROM med_schedule WHERE id = #{scheduleId} FOR UPDATE
